explication: Ultraviolet is a browser-side web proxy for accessing remote sites through a controlled sandbox. The documented flow is browser requests intercepted by a service worker, then proxy handling and response rewriting before content reaches the browser. The client layer adapts DOM, URL, storage, worker, and network APIs; the rewrite layer covers HTML, CSS, JavaScript, URLs, and cookies. The README establishes service-worker interception, while some handler and service-worker wiring is not visible in excerpts, so those links are marked unverified.
